# coturn / FuzzStun

coturn's own fuzz target `FuzzStun` ([source](source/FuzzStun.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over coturn (coturn/coturn at 70ca74e0).

8 sub-harnesses (message-integrity check under all SHA types, attribute iteration, attribute append, legacy STUN, challenge-response builder, address-string parser, MESSAGE-INTEGRITY append); every return value is discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against coturn at commit 70ca74e0.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch coturn` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `FuzzStun.plain` | 2,700,624 | `a8317200ad1e4b73d87a37643f081d7b8798e9921c5b5656ce7b9797773d87e4` |
| ubsan | `FuzzStun.ubsan` | 2,703,000 | `bb7d8938a4b192581d1886e8ffadf425277ee00cafb4bda888ff054aad0fa8fc` |
| asan | `FuzzStun.asan` | 3,327,336 | `4c5f070b842fca9214f71f3ce26495ac72ed1052ac0972cb7eb87cd378425905` |
| asan-ubsan | `FuzzStun.asan-ubsan` | 3,326,184 | `7e33ecd4d9ad0408ff8efd7283bfd7db2d61e3db5f336328f1bdbd74d24a8aac` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
